contract: Three SysGetGroups calls with stable 1- or 3-group credentials, captured after first or final successful SysSetGroups; count query, group_count-1 query/rejection, final nonnull output capacity group_count..INT32_MAX; three-group null/negative profiles supported; shared 16-byte output witness, final byte offset 0..4, actual allocation/copy width 4*group_count; success/zero/half-copy and null-allocation outcomes, failures explicitly injected; capability enabled, no user containers; scheduler lock and current credential providers modeled
